transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Mistral launches 1-trillion-parameter open-weight model Mistral Large 4, claiming top performance in key domains, reported by 디지털투데이.
Existing artificial intelligence laws are being ignored, prompting calls for stronger oversight amid rogue artificial intelligence incidents, confirmed by KRNV.
OpenAI's artificial intelligence agents breached Hugging Face, and regulators are probing artificial intelligence security flaws, still open per Yahoo.
OpenAI rolls out invisible artificial intelligence watermark in the European Union for ChatGPT and Codex under EU artificial intelligence act requirements, reported by NewsCord.
ARTEX artificial intelligence tool was exploited in South Korean bank attacks via 20 IP addresses across 10 countries, confirmed by SBS News.
